title: Gate-6B Mode-I Adaptive-Localization Stage 7: Layered Companion-Element / All_elem Reference-Fidelity Test (Corrected)

epistemic_findings.project_source_verified: Our governed f42_mixed_uel.for in Package 92 sets STRESS = 0.D0 and DDSDDE = 1.D-11, resulting in MISESERI = 0.0 across all 2,906 elements on All_elem.
epistemic_findings.unresolved_reference_detail: Pandey & Kumar (2025) submit Job-1_UEL.inp to obtain MISESERI on All_elem; their exact UMAT equations are not printed in text, but cited baseline Molnar & Gravouil (2017) implements an infinitesimal elastic constitutive update with E_dummy = 1e-11.
epistemic_findings.published_fig6a_scale_correction: Contour legend in Fig. 6(a) reports values from 1.47e-19 to 3.00e-12 (order 10^-12), aligning with the infinitesimal companion elasticity scale.

subroutine_audit.layer1_phase_uel: Solves phase-field Helmholtz equation, writes trial d to /CB_STATE_TRANS/
subroutine_audit.layer2_mech_uel: Solves degraded elasticity, supplies true AMATRX stiffness and RHS force, updates H
subroutine_audit.layer3_companion_umat: Sets STRESS = 0.D0 and DDSDDE = 1.D-11 in Package 92, reads /CB_STATE_TRANS/, writes SDV1..SDV20
